gen-dafont-redux-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps its capitals and ascenders clipped short, with wide-set terminals on the s. Redux stretches out above it, heavier in the verticals, like a gently tilted nib, and generous in its spacing.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its sans-serif letters far apart, with counters that breathe. Redux feels smoother beside it, its mild thick-thin shifts giving the heading a gliding pace the mono body deliberately lacks.

Redux enters every curved letter with a big, visible swoop, and its spacing runs wide throughout. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next counters with a plain sans whose lowercase eyes are huge and whose rounds stay unlatched, built for easy decoding.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clearly, with big e eyes and open small counters.  Its curves and stems move in lockstep, which makes a lovely foil to Redux, whose stress between stem and hairline sits medium-low.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-blinker: Redux swells gently on its curves and spaces its enlarged lowercase wide, giving headings a contemporary geometric presence. Blinker follows without any thinning at all.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-carrois-gothic: Wide, geometric and a bit theatrical, Redux lets a subtle gradient of weight run along each curve, while Carrois Gothic sits beneath with a high x-height and generous c openings. Redux earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Redux spreads its letters wide and thins its curves modestly where they turn, with a big entrance into each round. Carrois Gothic SC brings a clear opening to every curve, and capitals barely taller than lowercase.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-chocolate-classical-: Redux sets wide-spaced letters with the soft thick-thin shift of a pencil, and a big visible entrance into every curve. Chocolate Classical Sans takes over as the plain sans with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-comme: That big visible entrance into each curve is what Redux is about, with a mellow thick-thin difference and wide spacing. Comme reads smoothly across a longer passage, its lowercase filling most of the height and no curve clogging.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-cossette-texte: Calm describes Redux, whose weight varies gently from stem to serif and whose enlarged lowercase spreads wide. Cossette Texte is the wire-like monoline sans-serif, wide-eyed in its e.
